meaning: v. 洗；冲刷（waves wash the shore）。n. 洗、洗涤。wash up 洗餐具（英）；wash away 冲走；wash out 洗掉、取消。do the washing。washing machine。高考：wash one's hands of 不再过问。It will all come out in the wash. 终会水落石出。a wash 洗一次。Don't wash dirty linen in public.。wash up 英式洗碗，wash away 冲走；wash one's hands of 不再过问，属熟词僻义。
phrases: wash up（洗餐具）, wash away（冲走）, washing machine（洗衣机）
exampleEn: Please wash your hands before dinner.
exampleZh: 吃饭前请洗手。
root: 日常高频；wash up 英式多指洗碗

meaning: n. 毒药、毒物。v. 毒害、下毒。poisonous 有毒的。one man's meat is another man's poison 各有所好。poison sb against 使对…产生恶感。高考生物、安全：poisonous snakes。food poisoning 食物中毒。a poison 一种毒物。rat poison 灭鼠药。What's your poison? 想喝点什么（口语幽默）。
phrases: food poisoning（食物中毒）, poisonous（有毒的）, rat poison（灭鼠药）
exampleEn: Some mushrooms contain deadly poison.
exampleZh: 有些蘑菇含有剧毒。
root: poisonous 为形容词；food poisoning 为固定病名

meaning: v. / n. 奋斗、挣扎、搏斗。struggle to do；struggle for / against；struggle with。a power struggle。高考人物励志：struggle to succeed。struggle to one's feet 挣扎着站起来。the struggle for freedom。It's a struggle to 做…很费力。struggle on 挣扎着坚持。struggle to do/for/against/with 介词不同；struggle to one's feet 挣扎站起，励志阅读高频。
phrases: struggle to do（努力去做）, struggle for（为…而斗争）, struggle to one's feet（挣扎着站起）
exampleEn: She struggled to hold back her tears.
exampleZh: 她努力忍住眼泪。
root: 既表身体挣扎也表抽象奋斗

meaning: n. 缺点、不利条件、障碍。the main drawback of / to doing。every coin has two sides 的具体说法：One drawback is ...。高考议论文利弊分析高频替换 disadvantage。a serious drawback。overcome the drawbacks。区别 shortcoming（缺点，偏人/方案）、weakness。the only drawback。议论文利弊分析替换 disadvantage；the drawback of/to doing，反义 advantage。
phrases: the main drawback of（…的主要缺点）, a serious drawback（严重缺陷）, overcome drawbacks（克服缺点）
exampleEn: The only drawback of the job is the long hours.
exampleZh: 这份工作唯一的缺点是工时长。
root: draw back → 把人拉回去的因素 → 缺点

meaning: v. 沸腾、煮。n. 沸点时的沸腾。boil over 沸溢出；发怒。boiling point 沸点；boiling water 开水。It boils down to 归根结底。高考实验、烹饪。bring to the boil 煮沸。make one's blood boil 使怒火中烧。boiled eggs 煮鸡蛋。Don't let the milk boil over.。boiling point 沸点；boil over 溢出或发怒；it boils down to 归根结底，实验与习语并重。
phrases: boiling point（沸点）, boil over（沸溢出；发怒）, it boils down to（归根结底）
exampleEn: Water boils at 100 degrees centigrade.
exampleZh: 水在100摄氏度沸腾。
root: boil over 既表溢出也表情绪爆发

meaning: n. 祖先、祖宗；（事物的）原型。one's ancestors；ancestor worship 祭祖。形容词 ancestral；名词 ancestry 家系。反义 descendant 后代。高考历史、文化、生物进化：our ancestors lived in caves。a common ancestor 共同祖先。区别 forefather（偏男性祖先，较旧）。
phrases: one's ancestors（某人的祖先）, a common ancestor（共同祖先）, ancestral home（祖居）
exampleEn: Our ancestors left us many cultural treasures.
exampleZh: 我们的祖先给我们留下了许多文化遗产。
root: ante-(前) + cestor(走) → 走在前面的人

meaning: v. 做；行、足够（That will do.）；学习（do science）。aux. 构成疑问、否定、强调。不规则：do–did–done。do sb a favour；do with / without；do up 扣上、装修。have something to do with 与…有关。高考助动词与实义动词、do 短语。How do you do? 初次问候。do one's bit。
phrases: do sb a favour（帮某人忙）, have something to do with（与…有关）, That will do（那就行了）
exampleEn: Would you please do me a favour?
exampleZh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？
root: 助动词与实义动词兼有；do–did–done

meaning: adj. 强大的、有力的、效力大的。a powerful country / argument / medicine。副词 powerfully。名词 power。反义 powerless / weak。高考议论文：powerful evidence。a powerful influence。powerfully built 体格强壮。区别 strong（体力/程度）、mighty（文学性强）。powerful engine。可修饰国家、论据、药物；powerless 无力的，议论文 powerful evidence 有力证据。
phrases: a powerful argument（有力论据）, powerfully（强有力地）, powerless（无力的）
exampleEn: She made a powerful speech about climate change.
exampleZh: 她就气候变化作了一次有力的演讲。
root: power + -ful → 充满力量的

meaning: n. / v. 投票、表决。vote for / against；vote on 就…表决。cast a vote 投票。voter 选民；voting 投票。the right to vote。高考政治、班级选举。a vote of thanks 鸣谢辞。put it to the vote 付诸表决。by a majority vote。I vote (that) 我建议（口语）。vote for 赞成、against 反对、on 就议题表决；cast a vote 投票，voter 选民。
phrases: vote for（投票赞成）, vote against（投票反对）, cast a vote（投票）
exampleEn: Most students voted for the new class monitor.
exampleZh: 大多数学生投票选了新班长。
root: vote for / against 方向相反；on 表表决议题

meaning: adj. 直的；整齐的；连续的（five straight wins）；坦诚的。adv. 径直、立即（go straight home；straight away）。straighten 使变直。keep a straight face 忍住不笑。高考 straight away = immediately。set sb straight 纠正某人。straight A student 全优生。反义 bent / crooked。straight away 立刻；go straight home 直接回家；keep a straight face 忍住不笑。
phrases: straight away（立刻）, go straight home（直接回家）, keep a straight face（忍住不笑）
exampleEn: Please come to my office straight away.
exampleZh: 请立刻到我办公室来。
root: 既表空间“直”也表时间“立刻”；straight away 高频

meaning: adj. 相互矛盾的、对立的。contradictory opinions / evidence。动词 contradict 反驳、与…矛盾；名词 contradiction。be contradictory to。高考阅读中两处信息相反时用。self-contradictory 自相矛盾的。It is contradictory to say ...。区别 opposite（相反的，不一定逻辑冲突）。
phrases: contradictory opinions（矛盾的看法）, be contradictory to（与…矛盾）, self-contradictory（自相矛盾的）
exampleEn: The two witnesses gave contradictory accounts.
exampleZh: 两名证人的说法相互矛盾。
root: contra-(反对) + dict(说) + -ory

meaning: v. 握住；举行（hold a meeting）；容纳；持有观点。不规则：hold–held–held。n. 抓住、控制。hold on 等一下、坚持；hold back 隐瞒、忍住；hold up 举起、耽搁。catch / get hold of。高考短语极多。hold one's breath。hold true 适用。take hold 开始产生影响。
phrases: hold on（等一下；坚持）, hold a meeting（举行会议）, hold back（忍住；隐瞒）
exampleEn: The school will hold a sports meeting next week.
exampleZh: 学校下周将举行运动会。
root: hold–held–held；hold on / back / up 必掌握

meaning: n. 优点、有利条件、优势。take advantage of ①利用（机会）②占…便宜。have an advantage over 优于。to one's advantage 对某人有利。advantageous 有利的。反义 disadvantage / drawback。高考利弊作文黄金词。at an advantage。the advantage of doing。take advantage of 可褒（利用机会）可贬（占便宜）；have an advantage over 优于。
phrases: take advantage of（利用）, have an advantage over（优于）, to one's advantage（对某人有利）
exampleEn: You should take advantage of this chance to practise.
exampleZh: 你应利用这次机会多练习。
root: take advantage of 语境可褒可贬

meaning: n. 比赛、竞争。in competition with；enter a competition。动词 compete；形容词 competitive；competitor 竞争者。fierce competition。高考校园赛事：speech competition。out of competition 不参赛。competition for 对…的争夺。fair competition。win a competition。compete 动词，competitive 形容词，competitor 对手；in competition with 与…竞争，校园赛事高频。enter a competition 报名参赛，fierce competition 激烈竞争。
phrases: in competition with（与…竞争）, speech competition（演讲比赛）, competitive（有竞争力的）
exampleEn: She won first prize in the English competition.
exampleZh: 她在英语竞赛中获得一等奖。
root: com-(共同) + pet(追求) → 共同争求

meaning: n. 便宜货；协议。v. 讨价还价（bargain with sb about / over）。a good bargain；bargain price。bargain for 预料到（比预期：more than I bargained for）。高考购物场景。It's a bargain. 真便宜。drive a hard bargain 极力讨价还价。into the bargain 而且、另外。a good bargain 便宜货；bargain with sb 讲价；more than one bargained for 出乎意料。
phrases: a good bargain（便宜货）, bargain with（与…讨价还价）, more than one bargained for（出乎意料）
exampleEn: I got this coat for 50 yuan — a real bargain.
exampleZh: 这件外套我50元买的——真便宜。
root: 购物“便宜货”与动词“讲价”并重

meaning: n. 荣誉、尊敬。v. 尊敬、给予荣誉。英式 honour（美 honor）。in honour of 为纪念、向…表示敬意。It's an honour to do。honourable 光荣的。do sb honour。高考 in honour of 应用文、纪念类阅读。an honour student 优等生。on one's honour 以名誉担保。Excel 词形为英式 honour。
phrases: in honour of（为纪念；向…致敬）, it's an honour to（做…是荣幸）, honourable（光荣的）
exampleEn: A ceremony was held in honour of the heroes.
exampleZh: 举行仪式以纪念这些英雄。
root: 英式 -our；in honour of 为高考黄金短语

meaning: v. 承认；告知收到；致谢。acknowledge doing / that；acknowledge sb as / to be。It is widely acknowledged that 人们普遍认为（高考写作句型）。acknowledgement 承认、致谢。acknowledge a letter 告知来信收悉。区别 admit（认错、允许进入）、recognise（认出、承认身份）。
phrases: it is widely acknowledged that（人们普遍认为）, acknowledge doing（承认做了）, acknowledgement（致谢）
exampleEn: It is widely acknowledged that reading is important.
exampleZh: 人们普遍认为阅读很重要。
root: 比 admit 更中性，可表公开承认事实

meaning: n. 两星期（英式常用）。a fortnight's holiday；in a fortnight = in two weeks。fortnightly 两周一次的。高考英式时间表达。this day fortnight 两周后的今天。区别 weekend / month。美语多用 two weeks。a fortnight ago。once a fortnight 每两周一次。英式两星期；in a fortnight=in two weeks，fortnightly 两周一次，美语多用 two weeks。
phrases: in a fortnight（两周后）, a fortnight's holiday（两周假期）, once a fortnight（每两周一次）
exampleEn: We will be back in a fortnight.
exampleZh: 我们两周后回来。
root: fourteen nights 缩略 → 十四夜 ≈ 两周

meaning: n. 防御、辩护、国防（英式 defence；美 defense）。in defence of 为保卫、为…辩护。defend 保卫；defensive 防御的。national defence。高考法律、体育、军事。the defence lawyer 辩护律师。speak in sb's defence。Excel 词形为英式 defence，不可改成 defense。a strong defence。
phrases: in defence of（为保卫；为…辩护）, national defence（国防）, defence lawyer（辩护律师）
exampleEn: He spoke in defence of his friend.
exampleZh: 他为朋友作了辩护。
root: defend 的名词；英式 -ce

meaning: v. 练习；实践；从业（practise medicine / law）（英式动词拼写；美式一律 practice）。practise doing。名词 practice（英名、美名动同形）。Practice makes perfect. 高考 practise doing 不接 to do。put into practice 付诸实践。Excel 词形为 practise，不可改成 practice。practise the piano。
phrases: practise doing（练习做）, practise medicine（行医）, put into practice（付诸实践）
exampleEn: You should practise speaking English every day.
exampleZh: 你应该每天练习说英语。
root: 英式动词 practise / 名词 practice；后接 doing

meaning: n. 衣服、衣着（总称，不可数）。an article / a piece of clothing 一件衣服。clothing industry。区别 clothes（复数形式，无单数）、cloth（布）、clothe（给…穿衣）。warm clothing。高考不可数与量词。food, clothing and shelter 衣食住。protective clothing 防护服。winter clothing。
phrases: a piece of clothing（一件衣服）, clothing industry（服装业）, protective clothing（防护服）
exampleEn: Warm clothing is necessary in winter.
exampleZh: 冬天需要保暖的衣着。
root: 不可数总称；clothes 为复数概念

meaning: n. / v. 影响。have an influence on / upon；under the influence of。influential 有影响力的。高考写作：have a great influence on。influence sb to do。区别 affect（动词“影响”更常用）、effect（名词“效果”）。a positive influence。bad influence on children。have an influence on 对…有影响；influential 有影响力的，与 affect 动词、effect 名词配套辨析。under the influence of 在…影响下，写作高频。
phrases: have an influence on（对…有影响）, under the influence of（在…影响下）, influential（有影响力的）
exampleEn: Teachers have a great influence on their students.
exampleZh: 教师对学生有很大影响。
root: in-(入) + flu(流) → 流入而起作用

meaning: n. 肉（人或动物的软组织）；果肉。flesh and blood 血肉之躯、亲人。in the flesh 本人、活生生地。flesh out 充实（内容）。高考：see a star in the flesh。区别 meat（食用肉）、muscle（肌肉）。one's own flesh and blood 亲骨肉。the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.。in the flesh 亲眼见到本人；flesh and blood 亲人，区别 meat 食用肉。
phrases: in the flesh（本人；活生生地）, flesh and blood（血肉之躯；亲人）, flesh out（充实）
exampleEn: I was excited to meet the writer in the flesh.
exampleZh: 能见到作家本人我很激动。
root: in the flesh 为熟词僻义：亲眼见到本人

meaning: n. 娱乐、消遣。recreation centre / ground 娱乐中心/场地。a form of recreation。动词 recreate（消遣；亦作“再创造”，重音不同）。recreational 娱乐的。高考课余活动：outdoor recreation。for recreation。区别 entertainment（娱乐，更广、含表演业）、hobby。recreation facilities。
phrases: recreation centre（娱乐中心）, outdoor recreation（户外休闲）, recreational（娱乐的）
exampleEn: Reading is my favourite form of recreation.
exampleZh: 阅读是我最喜欢的消遣方式。
root: re-(再) + creat(创造) → 再创造精力 → 消遣

meaning: n. 入室窃贼。burglary 入室盗窃；burgle / burglarize 入室行窃。burglar alarm 防盗铃。区别 thief（小偷，泛称）、robber（抢劫犯，含当面暴力）、pickpocket（扒手）。高考安全、新闻。The burglar broke in at night. catch a burglar。anti-burglar 防盗的。
phrases: burglar alarm（防盗铃）, burglary（入室盗窃）, catch a burglar（抓住窃贼）
exampleEn: A burglar broke into the house while they were away.
exampleZh: 他们外出时有窃贼破门而入。
root: 专指闯入建筑物行窃者，区别 robber / thief

meaning: v. ①成功（succeed in doing，不接 to do）；②继承（succeed to the throne；succeed sb as）。success 成功（n.）；successful 成功的。反义 fail。高考 succeed in doing 与 be successful in。a success 成功的人或事。Nothing succeeds like success. 一事成则事事成。succeed in doing 成功，succeed to 继承；success 名词，successful 形容词，不接 to do 表成功。
phrases: succeed in doing（成功做成）, succeed to（继承）, succeed sb as（接替某人为）
exampleEn: She succeeded in getting a scholarship.
exampleZh: 她成功获得了奖学金。
root: suc-(随后) + ceed(走) → 跟着走到目标；后接 in doing

meaning: n. / adj. 最小量、最低限度；最小的。a minimum of；minimum wage 最低工资。复数 minima / minimums。副词 minimally；动词 minimise。反义 maximum。高考数量、规定：at a minimum 至少。keep to a minimum 保持最低。the minimum age。minimum temperature。与 maximum 相对；minimum wage 最低工资，at a minimum 至少，minimise 为动词。
phrases: a minimum of（最少）, minimum wage（最低工资）, at a minimum（至少）
exampleEn: You need a minimum of six hours' sleep.
exampleZh: 你至少需要六个小时的睡眠。
root: mini(小) + -mum 最高级意味 → 最小

meaning: v. 需要、要求。require doing / to be done（主动表被动，同 need / want）；require sb to do；require that + (should) do。requirement 要求。meet the requirements。高考非谓语与虚拟。as required 按照要求。This job requires patience. 区别 request（请求，语气弱）、demand（强硬要求）。require doing 主动表被动；require that+(should)do 虚拟；requirement 要求，meet the requirements。
phrases: require doing（需要被…）, require sb to do（要求某人做）, meet the requirements（符合要求）
exampleEn: The door requires painting. / The door requires to be painted.
exampleZh: 这扇门需要油漆一下。
root: require doing 主动表被动；从句用虚拟 should do

meaning: n. 医师、内科医生（相对 surgeon 外科医生）。family physician 家庭医生。高考职业、就医。physician 比 doctor 更正式、偏内科。physics 物理（形近）；physicist 物理学家。a chief physician 主任医师。see a physician。区别 dentist / oculist 等专科。
phrases: family physician（家庭医生）, chief physician（主任医师）, surgeon（外科医生）
exampleEn: You should see a physician if the pain continues.
exampleZh: 如果疼痛持续，你应该去看内科医生。
root: physic(医术) + -ian；勿混 physicist 物理学家

meaning: prep. / adv. 在…上方（不接触）；以上。adj. 上述的（the above）。above all 首先、尤其（高考高频）。above average；as above 如上。区别 over（可接触、覆盖）、on（接触表面）。above oneself 自高自大。from above。the sky above。above suspicion 无可怀疑。
phrases: above all（首先；尤其）, above average（高于平均）, as above（如上）
exampleEn: Above all, you must be honest with your friends.
exampleZh: 最重要的是，你必须对朋友诚实。
root: above all 为语篇衔接高频；与 over / on 辨析

meaning: n. 生态学；生态。ecological 生态的；ecologist 生态学家。ecological balance / system（= ecosystem）。高考环保主题核心词。protect the ecology。human ecology。ecology of the rainforest。disturb the ecology。区别 environment（环境，更日常）、biology（生物学，更广）。ecological balance 生态平衡，ecosystem 生态系统，环保写作核心词，区别 environment。
phrases: ecological balance（生态平衡）, ecosystem（生态系统）, ecological（生态的）
exampleEn: We must protect the ecology of the wetlands.
exampleZh: 我们必须保护湿地生态。
root: eco-(家、环境) + -logy(学科)

meaning: n. 污垢、泥土（不可数）。dirty 脏的。treat sb like dirt 视如草芥。hit the dirt 扑倒在地。a dirt road 土路。高考：wash the dirt off。dig in the dirt 挖土；揭短。as cheap as dirt 极便宜。区别 soil（土壤，种植）、mud（泥浆）、dust（灰尘）。dirt cheap。不可数；dirty 脏的，treat sb like dirt 视如草芥，dirt road 土路，区别 soil 土壤。
phrases: treat sb like dirt（视如草芥）, a dirt road（土路）, dirt cheap（极便宜）
exampleEn: Please wash the dirt off your shoes.
exampleZh: 请把鞋上的泥土洗掉。
root: 不可数；形容词 dirty

meaning: n. 邮件；职位；柱、杆；帖子。v. 邮寄（英）；张贴；发帖。the post office；by post。post a letter（英）= mail（美）。keep sb posted 随时告知。高考多义：职位 a teaching post；社交网络 post。post up 张贴。lamp post 灯柱。poster 海报。Excel 保留 post 本身。
phrases: post office（邮局）, by post（通过邮寄）, keep sb posted（随时告知）
exampleEn: Could you post this letter for me?
exampleZh: 你能帮我寄这封信吗？
root: 英式邮寄用 post；美式多用 mail；兼表职位与发帖
